ValidationRule.description: Story Verification Gate: blocks Ready to Promote when the story has never been verified.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Permission.Bypass_Verification_Gate), AND(copado__Promote_Change__c = TRUE, OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(copado__Promote_Change__c))), ISPICKVAL(Verification_Status__c, "") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Run verification first: click Verify on this story, then tick Ready to Promote again.
